items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Nat Siegel had the other club. In fact, that’s where I was discovered...

ctx.x: Nat Siegel had the other club. In fact, that’s where I was discovered, in a sense, by Johnnie “Scat” Davis who came in, and sat in while we were playing and offered me a job and went out on the road, I was fifteen.
That’s amazing. And so when, so how, he offered to take you on the road and didn’t he have to sign guardian papers for you?
